The Story

About the Stylist

Stylist. Jewelry designer. Storyteller.

It started when I was a kid, watching my grandmother sew. She'd take me with her to the fabric stores, and I'd spend hours running my hands over bolts of cloth while she picked patterns and textures apart with an expert eye. That's where playing dress-up turned into something more — I had an unusual body, curvy in a way that didn't match what I saw around me, and I had to learn early how to accentuate what I loved and quiet what I didn't. That skill became instinct.

It followed me into fine jewelry, where I learned to dress people for the biggest nights of their lives — including the Met Gala — thinking in proportion, balance, and the story a single piece can tell about the person wearing it.

What I love most hasn't changed since those days in the fabric store: helping someone else feel beautiful, and watching them find — really find — their own personal style. That's what this is.
